name: make_notes
description: Student pack: turns a topic, a pasted text or a file into clean revision notes saved as a Word document (maths shown as real equations). Use for 'make notes on the French revolution', 'turn this into revision notes', 'summarise chapter 4 into notes'.
instructions: 1. Get the source: a topic they named, text they pasted or selected, or a file (read_file). If it is only a topic, you may call web_search once or twice for accurate facts. 2. Write revision notes: a title, key terms with one-line definitions, the main points as short bullet lists, worked examples where it helps, and a 5-question 'Test yourself' section at the end. Write any maths in LaTeX between $...$ (inline) or $$...$$ (display) so the Word file shows proper equations. 3. Call write_file to save it as '<Topic> notes.docx' in the workspace. 4. Reply in one or two sentences with where it was saved; do not read the whole notes out loud unless they ask.
